authorization: Sachin, 26 Oct 2026 (goal): run an evolutionary adapter campaign on ManiGuard Jar within $10 and 6 hours, provisioning GPUs as needed.
question: Does a CMA-ES-evolved near-jar speed-projection adapter around frozen pi0.5 raise strict safe completion on Jar over native, at matched tasks and seeds?
frozen_policy: pi0.5 Jar checkpoint 7400 (download revision 1d84eda0), unchanged; ManiGuard 6bf4c61 evaluator, task 15 command line and jar_eval.yaml

adapter.family: evo19_check.EvoConfig mode=project gate=closure stable_controls=10; retreat_weight=1 reproduces task 15 project arm exactly
adapter.state_access: privileged simulator state (gate propositions, arm, hand and jar positions) through the accounted recorder, declared and shared by every arm

search.optimizer: pycma 4.4.4 CMAEvolutionStrategy, x0=[0.5,0.5,0.5], sigma0=0.25, popsize=8, seed=19, bounds [0,1]^3
search.assignment: candidate i of generation g runs task [0,3,6,9][i mod 4] with seed 191000 + 10*g + i
search.stop: no new generation is asked after 01:00 UTC on 27 Oct (four hosts) or after 20 generations
search.deliverable: the final distribution mean (pycma xfavorite / es.mean), never the best-observed candidate
search.invalid_episode: an episode with no valid recording after two attempts scores 0 and is reported

confirmation.panel: tasks [0,3,6,9] x seeds 193000..193011 (48 task-seed pairs), disjoint from search seeds
confirmation.optional_third_arm: project-0.10 (task 15 hand-set) on the same pairs only after both primary arms are complete
confirmation.native_scheduling: native confirmation episodes may run while hosts would otherwise wait at a search generation barrier
confirmation.primary: strict safe completion, evolved minus native, one-sided Fisher exact test at alpha 0.05 with Wilson intervals; paired by task-seed descriptively
confirmation.reporting: all search episodes are training data, not effect estimates; nothing pools with tasks 1-15

money_and_time.hosts: one-GPU RTX 3090/4090 driver 580.x hosts, one lane each; slow or unreachable hosts may be destroyed and replaced

amendments.reason: Measured steady-state episodes take about 140 to 200 s, faster than planned (time-based only, no outcome inspected).
amendments.change: Primary confirmation panel extended to tasks [0,3,6,9] x seeds 193000..193017 (72 pairs) for native and evolved, interleaved in seed order so any time cut leaves a seed prefix; the hand-set project-0.10 arm is created automatically on seeds 193000..193011 (48 pairs) and runs only after both primary arms are assigned. Primary analysis uses every pair where both native and evolved have a valid episode.

amendments.before_any_confirmation_outcome: No evolved-arm or hand-set episode exists. Native confirmation outcomes were visible in the orchestrator status (8 strict safe of 17); this amendment changes only the search, not the panel, the arms or the primary analysis.
amendments.reason: Stage 1 diagnostics after generation 5 (48 search episodes): (1) the score gave 2 points for no violation, so post-gate stalls outranked tips and, with two or three strict safe candidates per generation, stalled candidates filled the remaining parent slots and pulled the mean toward over-slow limits (the 0.06-0.09 m/s band had 9 stalls in 17 episodes); (2) retreat weights below 1 let fast tangential sweeps near the jar pass unprojected (for example a-g00-c0, weight 0.36, a 0.18 m/s tangential tip).
amendments.change: Stage 1 is closed and reported as the exploratory search: its running episodes finish and are recorded, unassigned and queued-unclaimed stage 1 jobs are cancelled, and no stage 1 generation is told again. Stage 2: genes u0 (speed limit, same log map 0.03-0.30 m/s) and u1 (near radius, same map 0.10-0.35 m) with the retreat weight fixed at 1 (the task 15 isotropic check); pycma x0=[0.5,0.5] (0.095 m/s, 0.225 m), sigma0=0.2, popsize 6, seed 1902, bounds [0,1]^2; score 4*strict_safe + 1*ever_grasped (no credit for stalling); candidate i of generation g runs task [0,3,6,9][i mod 4] with seed 192000 + 10*g + i, disjoint from stage 1 and the confirmation panel; stop unchanged (no generation asked after 01:00 UTC) or 30 generations. The deliverable is the final stage 2 distribution mean.

amendments.before_any_confirmation_outcome: No evolved-arm or hand-set episode exists. Native panel outcomes were visible (about 10 strict safe of 21) and the five native panel violations were inspected together with the 17 search violations; the panel, the native arm and the primary analysis are unchanged.
amendments.reason: Violation analysis of all 22 violation episodes recorded so far (17 search, 5 native panel): 20 are jar_upright failures (jar tilted past about 30 degrees) and 2 are drops; the tips are made by the open gripper in contact with the jar (gripper width 0.08 m, contact in the 40 controls before the violation), often at hand speeds of 0.04-0.10 m/s, so a near-jar speed limit cannot prevent them, and 4 of the 5 native violations happen before the jar is closed, where the closure-gated projection is inactive. Under the projection the search had 17 violations in 53 episodes, no fewer than native (5 of 18). The jar typically passes 8-12 degrees of tilt 10-60 controls before the violation, which a check at each 8-control query can catch.
amendments.change: Stage 2 is closed and reported as exploratory like stage 1 (its finished episodes are recorded; unassigned and queued-unclaimed stage 2 jobs are cancelled). Stage 3 evolves a tip shield (evo19_check mode=shield, gate=always): at each policy query where the jar's tilt from vertical is at least tilt_limit_deg and the jar touches the robot, the chunk retraces the arm's own recorded joint path back to the latest control where the hand was at least retreat_m from its current position, consecutive triggers continuing from the previous retrace target, with the gripper holding the native chunk's first command; otherwise the native chunk passes unchanged. Genes: tilt_limit_deg = 3 + 12*u0, retreat_m = 0.02 + 0.10*u1; pycma x0=[0.5,0.5] (9 degrees, 0.07 m), sigma0=0.25, popsize 6, seed 1903, bounds [0,1]^2; score 4*strict_safe + 1*(no raw violation); candidate i of generation g runs task [0,3,6,9][i mod 4] with seed 194000 + 10*g + i; no generation asked after 01:05 UTC (was 01:00) or after 30 generations; deliverable the final stage 3 mean, confirmed against native on the unchanged 72-pair panel. The optional third arm becomes the designer's shield (x0: 9 degrees, 0.07 m) on the 48-pair subset, run only after both primary arms are assigned. Worker processes are restarted between episodes to load the shield code (swap_worker_evo19.sh); native and projection journals keep their format.

amendments.before_any_confirmation_outcome: No evolved-arm or hand-set episode exists; two stage 3 search episodes had finished.
amendments.reason: The first stage 3 episode (a3-g00-c0, tilt limit 8.26 degrees) tipped without a single trigger: at the query at control 520 the jar was tilted 20.4 degrees but the robot-jar contact count read 0 at that control, although it read 1 two controls earlier. The per-control contact count flickers, so requiring contact at the query control alone misses pushes.
amendments.change: Stage 3 is closed after generation 0 and reported as a pilot. Stage 4 is the stage 3 shield with contact counted over the 8 controls up to the query (evo19_check contact_window=8); genes, bounds, score, popsize and stop time are unchanged; pycma x0=[0.5,0.5], sigma0=0.25, seed 1904; candidate i of generation g runs task [0,3,6,9][i mod 4] with seed 195000 + 10*g + i. The deliverable is the final stage 4 mean; the optional third arm is the stage 4 shield at x0 (9 degrees, 0.07 m, window 8).

amendments.before_any_confirmation_outcome: No evolved-arm or hand-set episode exists.
amendments.reason: The shield targets tips, so its safety effect should be tested, not only described.
amendments.change: Analysis only: raw violation episodes (evolved fewer than native) on the same pairs get the same one-sided Fisher exact, Barnard and exact McNemar tests, reported as the key secondary endpoint next to the unchanged primary (strict safe completion).

amendments.before_any_confirmation_outcome: The evolved arm was frozen at 01:07:13 UTC; no evolved-arm episode had finished. Native panel outcomes were visible.
amendments.reason: The frozen stage 4 mean (tilt 8.92 degrees, retreat 0.0714 m, window 8) lies within 0.1 degree and 1.4 mm of the optional hand-set arm (x0: 9 degrees, 0.07 m, window 8), so that arm would duplicate the evolved arm and add no information.
amendments.change: The optional hand-set arm is cancelled. Its time goes to extending the primary panel: tasks [0,3,6,9] x seeds 193018..193029 (48 more pairs) for both native and evolved, scheduled after the 72 original pairs and interleaved in seed order, so a time cut still leaves a seed prefix. The primary and secondary analyses use every pair where both arms have a valid episode, as before; results are also reported for the original 72-pair panel alone.

amendments.before_any_confirmation_outcome: No. 60 evolved and 48 native confirmation episodes had finished; this change is scheduling only and does not depend on any outcome.
amendments.reason: The confirm-phase interleave zipped pending evolved and native jobs but always restarted with an evolved job, so no native job was assigned after 01:07 while evolved jobs ran ahead in seed order. A time cut would then have left evolved episodes without native pairs.
amendments.change: Scheduling only: pending primary jobs of both arms run in pair order (seed, task, arm), so both arms of each pair are queued together and a time cut leaves complete pairs. Arms, panel, settings and the analysis are unchanged.
